svg.aria-label: pipekit-train on the GeoStack role ladder: TrainingLoop and HyperSweep as recipes, the trained-model operators and ValidationStep as steps, the backends' run functions and train_step as algorithms, the train and carry states as models, losses, tasks, callbacks and writers as strategies, hashing, loss and checkpoint calls as primitives, and the datasets as structures; the optimisers and samplers of optax, NumPyro and BlackJAX and the sharding setup sit beside the ladder, all on pipekit-ops.
